0.comment: Letter spacing 0% of the font size → CSS 0. The meaning is in the name; the exporter (≥ 1.1.0) derives the value from it and ignores the stored number. Not bindable: Figma would apply it as pixels. Text styles type the percentage instead. Used by: Captions, labels. See minis-design-system todo-plans/015.

3.comment: Letter spacing 3% of the font size → CSS 0.03em. The meaning is in the name; the exporter (≥ 1.1.0) derives the value from it and ignores the stored number. Not bindable: Figma would apply it as pixels. Text styles type the percentage instead. Used by: Brand lg/xl. See minis-design-system todo-plans/015.

n0_3.comment: Letter spacing -0.3% of the font size → CSS -0.003em. Written with a comma because Figma does not allow "." in variable names. The meaning is in the name; the exporter derives the value from it and ignores the stored number. Not bindable: Figma would apply it as pixels. Text styles type the percentage instead. Used by: Body md/sm. See minis-design-system todo-plans/015.
